step1_analysis.description: A differential input transconductor with a cascode tail current source and PMOS active loads. Due to likely schematic extraction artifacts on the PMOS nodes (N1 and LABEL_NET_3), it is biased in the testbench to operate as a single-ended output Gm cell.

paper_reference.title: Generation of Accurate On-Chip Time Constants and Stable Transconductances

power.description: Total static power consumption of the circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail ≈ 0.5 * un * Cox * (W/L) * (Vgs - Vth)^2. With R1=0.7V, Vgs=0.7V, I_tail ≈ 100uA. Total power = VDD * I_tail = 1.8V * 100uA = 180uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the applied bias voltages (R1, R2, R3) which set the tail and load currents.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = Gm * Rout. Gm ≈ 1mS. Rout ≈ 1 / (lambda * I_tail) ≈ 100kOhm. Gain ≈ 100 V/V = 40 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard gain for a single-stage differential amplifier with active load in 130nm.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * CL). With Rout=100kOhm and CL=10fF, BW ≈ 159 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the order of magnitude of the frequencies reported in the paper (250-300 MHz).

vout_trip.description: Input voltage at which the output crosses VDD/2

sky130_expected.calculation: Should be close to the common-mode voltage of the negative input (INN = 0.9V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetry of the differential pair dictates the trip point is near the reference input voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Limited by VDD and the saturation voltage of the PMOS load.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The PMOS load will pull the output close to VDD when the NMOS is off.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC operating point, AC gain and bandwidth, DC transfer characteristics, and transient response of the Gm cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Gm cell testbench
.param W_xm1cas=5u L_xm1cas=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1CAS N2 R2 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1cas} w={W_xm1cas}
XM2 OUTN INP N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 N4 R1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM5 OUTP N1 LABEL_NET_3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM3 OUTP INN N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUTN R3 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* DC Sources and Biasing
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN1 N1 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 1.8
VR1 R1 0 0.7
VR2 R2 0 1.2
VR3 R3 0 0.9

* Inputs
VINN INN 0 DC 0.9 AC 0
VINP INP 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 10MEG 0 0)

* Load Capacitance
CL OUTN 0 10f

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8 - i(VN1)*1.8 - i(VLABEL_NET_3)*1.8
  print power

  * 2. DC Sweep for Trip Point
  dc VINP 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc vout_trip when v(OUTN)=0.9

  * 3. AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
  ac dec 10 1k 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(OUTN)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(dc_gain-3) fall=1

  * 4. Transient Analysis
  tran 1n 200n
  meas tran v_max max v(OUTN)
  meas tran v_min min v(OUTN)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
